# dsh-peak
A live **peak/off-peak pricing indicator** for the DeepSeek Harness, shipped as an installable dual-
k/off-peak pricing indicator** for the DeepSeek Harness, shipped as an installable dual-face bundle.
DeepSeek's API moved to peak/off-peak pricing on **2026-08-16 16:00 UTC**: during peak windows the r
ate is **2× the off-peak rate**, and the windows line up almost exactly with Chinese work hours. Wee
kends and Chinese statutory holidays are billed off-peak **all day**. This plugin makes that visible
ends and Chinese statutory holidays are billed off-peak **all day**. This plugin makes that visible:
- **Composer pill** (browser): a small always-visible control at the left of the input row — **red "
PEAK"** during peak windows, **green "OFF-PEAK"** otherwise, with a live countdown to the next switc

h and a hover tooltip showing UTC + Beijing times and the reason the day is off-peak.
- **`dsh_peak_
status` tool** (host): the agent can call it before suggesting or running long/expensive work, so it
can warn you when you're about to pay the peak rate.
## Pricing windows
Peak applies on days that are neither a weekend nor a Chinese statutory holiday:
| Window | Beijing | UTC |
f-peak | everything else | — (half of peak) |
Whole-day off-peak, since **2026-08-23 00:00 Beijing**:
| Day | Rule |

| Saturday + Sunday | off-peak all day, including make-up workdays (调休) that fall on a weekend |
| C
hinese statutory holidays | off-peak all day (DeepSeek notice of 2026-09-19) |
Holidays follow the State Council's annual arrangement (国办发明电〔2025〕7号). The 2026 table covers Mid-Au
tumn (Sep 25) and National Day (Oct 1–7), which — with the Sep 20 and Oct 10 make-up weekends — make
Sep 20 to Oct 10, 2026 almost entirely off-peak.
## Holiday data
`core.js` holds the whole-day rules: `HOLIDAYS` (inclusive Beijing date ranges, listed only from the
2026-09-19 notice onward), `MAKEUP_WORKDAYS` (labels only — a make-up workday is off-peak because i
t is a weekend), and `HOLIDAY_CALENDAR_THROUGH`, the last date the table covers. The State Council p
ublishes the next year's arrangement each November, so update all three when it lands; until then th
e tool appends a warning to its summary and the pill's tooltip, because holidays after that date wou
ld be misreported as peak.
Both halves run the same code: `index.js` imports `core.js`, while the browser bundle embeds the mar
ked region from `core.js` verbatim (a bundle is served as one script and cannot import a sibling mod
egion from `core.js` verbatim (a bundle is served as one script and cannot import a sibling module).
## Requirements
- A DeepSeek Harness **web profile** (the pill mounts in the browser; the tool registers host-side)
- No runtime dependencies — the host half uses a raw `ctx.tools.register` definition and the client
bundle's only external is `react`
## Install

Or from a local checkout of this repo:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin` runs `pnpm add` in the profile directory and registers the package as a bundle layer (`
dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`). After the next `dsh web` restart, both halves activate: the
host row registers `dsh_peak_status`, and the `dsh.client` declaration makes the browser roster ser
ve `/plugins/dsh-peak/client.js`, mounting the pill in every session.
## Usage
Ask the agent:

- *"is it peak pricing right now?"* → calls `dsh_peak_status`
- *"run this long job off-peak"* → the
agent checks `dsh_peak_status` first and reports the window
The pill itself needs no interaction: it self-updates every 30s and flips color at each window bound
pill itself needs no interaction: it self-updates every 30s and flips color at each window boundary.
`dsh_peak_status` returns the `summary` an agent reads plus structured fields: `peak`, `offPeakReaso
n` (`weekend` / `holiday` / `none`, the last when only the peak-window rule applies), `holidayName`
(empty unless the day is a holiday), `makeupWorkday`, the UTC and Beijing clocks, `nextSwitchUtc` /
`nextSwitchInMinutes`, and `holidayCalendarThrough` / `holidayCalendarStale`.
Tool schemas use the harness's JSON-schema subset, which takes a single `type` string per node — a `
type` array disables the whole plugin entry at load, so `offPeakReason` carries the `none` sentinel
instead of a nullable type.
## Development
The repo is deliberately build-free: `core.js`, `index.js` (host tool), and `client.js` (browser bun

`npm test` runs the smoke suite: host identity + tool registration, window and whole-day classificat
ion at known instants (09:46 UTC → peak; 05:00 UTC → off-peak; Mid-Autumn and National Day → off-pea
k all day, including the switch that skips the whole National Day break; make-up workday weekends),
a check that `client.js` still embeds the current `core.js`, and client bundle materialization again
st a stubbed module loader + React.
